_comment: Single source of truth for JHAI's shadcn registry namespaces. Merge this 'registries' block into any project's components.json. The shadcn MCP server reads its registry list from components.json, so this block is what arms component search in Claude Code. Every URL below was verified by fetching a real registry item on 2026-09-12; see docs/RESEARCH.md section A.
_rules: Namespace names must start with '@' and URLs must contain '{name}' (shadcn skill spec, skills/shadcn/mcp.md). Both are enforced by the CLI.

Suffixes are NOT uniform. @tailark-oss and @intentui have no .json; @diceui and @nusaiba carry a {style} or a fixed style segment. Each was verified by fetching a real item. Do not normalize them to match the others.
Search and list resolve the registry index by substituting {name} with 'registry'. A namespace only supports search if that path serves a valid registry.json.
A public index does NOT mean public items. @reui serves a 1728-item index anonymously and 401s on every item with 'Provide your license key'. Probe a real ITEM before wiring, never just the index.
Pin the CLI major in anything that runs across many sites: use 'shadcn@4.21.0' via pnpm dlx, not 'shadcn@latest'.

A registry can be VERIFIED and still not INSTALL. Four of the fifteen wired in the 2026-09-14 breadth pass failed only at install: @diceui declared an npm package that 404s, @payload-components needs a Payload CMS project, @7ovr and @intentui assume a different primitive base (Base UI / react-aria) than shadcn's Radix. Always install-test before adding a namespace here.

_verified.method: index fetched; a real item fetched and parsed; restylability measured (semantic vs palette utilities vs hex); LICENSE read from source repo; one real install per registry into a throwaway on a non-JHAI palette, typechecked and built
_verified.candidatePool: 344 in the community index, 271 healthy and unwired, 263 verified, 262 free (34,969 items). Only @reui is key-gated.

buildVerified.method: every item installed into a throwaway Next 16 project on the shadcn default neutral palette, typechecked, built, and mounted in headless Chromium

_unwired.rule: A registry is unwired when its measured usable rate is under 25% after the harness defects are fixed, unless it is the only source for a capability nothing else covers. Re-wiring is one line; see docs/BUILD-STATUS.json for the evidence.

@vllnt-ui.why: Every request to ui.vllnt.com returns HTTP 403, including the site root, with and without a browser User-Agent. It answered when it was wired on 2026-09-14. A namespace that 403s is not a source.

@nusaiba.why: 15 usable of 119. 100 items fail on "Cannot find module '../../sera/sera-motion'" — an internal path the registry ships imports of but never ships. Nothing here is unique; @hirael and @cnippet cover the same section shapes at 93% and 86%. Re-wire the day it declares that file.
